title.justification: This is the title of the paper.

extractions.description: The paper introduces conditional permutation invariant flows, a framework built on continuous normalizing flows that enables conditional set generation with a tractable density. It applies these flows to realistic traffic scene generation and bounding box prediction.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on a new machine learning method, and while it has applications in sustainable development, it is not central to the paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We present a conditional generative probabilistic model of set-valued data with a tractable log density.

primary_category.justification: The paper discusses traffic scene generation, which is related to transportation.
primary_category.quote: We illustrate the utility of this model via applications including (1) complex traffic scene generation conditioned on visually specified map information, and (2) object bounding box generation conditioned directly on images.
